data.title: 阿斯特蕾亚 · 草坪暖阳的羽翼遮阳伞
data.description: 绿草如茵的小镇山坡上，阿斯特蕾亚与你并肩躺在草地上。她展开两面巨大洁白的羽毛翅膀，像轻柔的毛毯般将你遮挡住刺眼的阳光，像小狗一样亲昵地蹭着你的手臂。
data.location: grassy meadow hill under wide summer sky
data.action: 并肩躺在草地上展开羽翼为对方遮阳，像小动物般亲昵蹭着手臂
data.lighting: brilliant summer daylight diffused softly by translucent white feathers
data.promptProse: Astraea lies in the wildflowers with her long blonde hair spread beneath a large white wing. The companion beside her is a brown-skinned man with cropped black hair, wearing a moss-green short-sleeved shirt. She nudges his upper arm as the wing casts dappled shade across their two faces.
